title: commits
description: explain-pr: the branch's commits with the intent of each, drawn as a graph like `git log --graph`, newest on top. List them oldest first, as `verstat facts diff` prints them. Clicking a commit emits `commits:select` on the page bus; the fragments of the `changes` blocks (and the doc fragments) that the commit does not touch are dimmed. Not rendered when `commits` is empty.

id.description: Part id, unique in the block; a route step can focus it.

sha.description: Commit sha, 7 to 64 lowercase hex characters (SHA-1 or SHA-256).

parents.description: Parent shas, as `verstat facts diff` prints them. The graph draws lanes from them; a commit with two or more parents is a merge. Without parents the commits are drawn one under another in one colour, without lines.

repo.description: Repo name from the page's repos, when the page has more than one.

intent.description: What the commit is for, in one line.

files.description: Paths the commit touches, as in `changes` `path`. `verstat facts diff` prints them.

external.description: A commit of the base branch that a merge in the range brought in (`external` in `verstat facts diff`): drawn dashed, without counts; it is not part of the diff.
